title: Nissan Chemical Corporation
content: Nissan Chemical Corporation is a Japanese advanced materials company offering colloidal silica, organosilica sol, and alumina sol products for industrial and technical applications. These chemistries are relevant to aerogel precursor, coating, catalyst-support, and refractory-oriented workflows in the broader sol-gel materials ecosystem. Nissan Chemical is a suitable Equipment Materials listing for teams evaluating inorganic dispersion and sol suppliers in Asia.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
